heading: Thursday, July 16, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: MiniMax Music 3.0 and Moonshot AI Kimi K3.

items.headline: MiniMax releases Music 3.0
items.summary: Music 3.0 generates complete songs of up to five minutes, including composition, arrangement, vocals and production, from a brief and optional lyrics. MiniMax published open weights for the roughly 11B-parameter system on August 13, 2026.

items.headline: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K3
items.summary: Kimi K3 is a 2.8-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model (16 of 896 experts active) with native vision and a 1M-token context window, built on Kimi Delta Attention. Moonshot claims frontier-level results while acknowledging it trails the top US models overall; it launched on Kimi.com, Kimi Code and the API, with full weights promised by July 27, 2026.
